{{Quote|I won't fail you, sir!|An Imperial Lance Corporal|<ref name="Threat of the Conqueror" />}}
'''Lance corporal''' was a military enlisted rank used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was higher than a [[Private/Legends|private]] but lower than a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]].

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lance corporal is an enlisted rank in the [[Wikipedia:United States Marine Corps|US Marines]] and the army in Commonwealth nations.
